title: The Lid Left Loose on the Honey
youtube_title: The Lid Left Loose on the Honey | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Honest words let a friend help with the repair.
summary: At a library table by the round window, Gita is tangled up with a honey lid left loose and almost hides it. Gita tells Miss Dalca the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
